name: likeit
title: Likeit
description: Like the current NetEase Music track once its identity can be verified.
author: cc_qq

commands.name: likeit
commands.title: Like Current Track
commands.description: Like the current playing NetEase Music track without unliking existing favorites.

preferences.name: successConfetti
preferences.title: Success Confetti
preferences.label: Celebrate newly liked tracks
preferences.description: Show confetti after a confirmed new favorite when macOS Reduce Motion is off.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
